feeds.title: Stop The Thyroid Madness Blog
feeds.description: Thyroid mistreatment using T4 medicine and hypothyroidism misdiagnosis are too common. Find out the truth about this ongoing scandal. STTM's mission is to spread the word about worldwide reported patient experiences and wisdom concerning better thyroid treatment and more, to help you in working wiser with your doctor.

feeds.title: TheHypothyroidismChick
feeds.description: Blog by Audrey Childers author, blogger and health journalist. Where she talks about her experiences with hypothyroidism. You can find recipes that have worked for her and her personal spin on things we can do to heal our body naturally.

feeds.title: Healthful Elements
feeds.description: We teach women with hormonal imbalances and autoimmune conditions how to support and nourish themselves with whole foods nutrition, holistic lifestyle choices, and other natural remedies so they can regain their vitality, emerge from the fog, and live symptom-free.

feeds.title: Paul Robinson Thyroid Blog
feeds.description: Paul Robinson is an active advocate for thyroid patients through his regular blog posts, which offer a wealth of information that both relate to his books as well as current news and insights. He is the author of 'The Thyroid Patient's Manual,' 'Recovering with T3,' and 'The CT3M Handbook,' all of which were written to help thyroid patients in recovering from hypothyroidism as quickly as possible.

feeds.title: Thyroidpharmacist
feeds.description: Enjoy the vast array of material that addresses the root causes of Hashimoto's & hypothyroidism and how you can start feeling better. Authored by Dr. Izabella Wentz. Izabella is a Fellow of the American Society of Consultant Pharmacists and holds certifications in Medication Therapy Management as well as Advanced Diabetes Care.

feeds.title: Hypothyroid Mom
feeds.description: Symptoms of hypothyroidism in women have devastating effects on well-being. Hypothyroid Mom reveals secrets about an underactive thyroid that will redefine health for the millions of mothers worldwide who suffer from this thyroid disease.

feeds.title: The Invisible Hypothyroidism
feeds.description: Thyroid advocate and blogger. I am one of the many faces of thyroid disease and I'm passionate about helping those with hypothyroidism and giving them a voice. Blog by Rachel.

feeds.title: Let's Share Dialogue
feeds.description: Shemeka Sumrall was diagnosed with hypothyroidism in 2004 after her thyroid removal. She's a performance consultant, creative and nonfiction writer, and socialite. She blogs about living with hypothyroidism and hopes her experiences, stories and those of others integrated within her blog will help educate others on this disease.
